visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Under bright natural daylight, a young woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a light pink sports top and white shorts, stands in front of a large traditional stone archway. She adjusts her dark sunglasses and poses with a slight smile while background tourists in casual attire walk up the stone steps behind her. The environment is lush with green foliage and tall stone pillars bordering the entrance. (2) The scene shifts slightly as she lifts one leg in a playful dance-like pose, pointing her fingers at the camera with a confident expression. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the textures of the stone walkway and the intricate carvings on the wooden plaque above the archway. (3) The environment transitions abruptly to night with artificial lighting illuminating the same archway. The woman is now seen from the side in a blurred motion, sprinting energetically toward the stone stairs. Transparent digital text overlays appear on the left side of the frame, displaying various fitness metrics such as distance and heart rate in white font.
